card.name: Chinese characters after Latin names
card.fires_on: The opening bracket or first byte of Chinese characters that follow a romanized name or title, as in Chinese names and Buddhist texts. It also fires weakly on a few plain English linking words.

modes.label: Before Chinese script
modes.description: The point just before Chinese characters give the native form of a romanized name or term.

modes.label: Broken Chinese character bytes
modes.description: A partial byte of a Chinese character right after a Sanskrit title.

modes.label: Scattered English linking words
modes.description: Weak firing on words like "to" or "sites" in dose or web text.

card.writes: It promotes Chinese tokens that begin names, titles and roles, so it prepares for Chinese text to follow.
card.plain: It fires where a Chinese-language name or title is about to be written out in characters.
